_comment: Title styles available to title_add. Edit freely: id (lower_snake_case), font, weight (400 normal, 700 bold), size (px at 1080p, scaled to the project height), color and outlineColor as r,g,b,a, outline (px), position (top | center | lower_third | bottom), fadeIn / fadeOut (seconds).

presets.description: white text with a thin outline in the lower third, 0.3s fades
medium caption at the top, no fades
subtitle-style text near the bottom edge, 0.15s fades
